Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		BankCard.allInstance()->includes(inputCard) or
		BankCard.allInstance()->excludes(inputCard)
	postcondition:
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.InputCard = inputCard and
		self.CardIDValidated = true and
		result = true or
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		self.CardIDValidated = false and
		result = false
}
